cases.name: Dr. Gwendolyn Lavonne Riddick
cases.about: UNC Health Rockingham wrote they were "devastated to share the tragic and unexpected passing of Dr. Gwendolyn Riddick. Dr. Riddick was a passionate and dedicated member of the UNC Women’s Health at Eden team since joining as an OB/GYN in 2021. We cannot begin to describe how much she will be missed by UNCPN, UNC Health Rockingham, her patients and the Rockingham community. Dr. Riddick was an extraordinary woman who made a difference in the lives of everyone she touched. We will remember her and the legacy of resilience and compassion she leaves behind. Our thoughts are with her family and loved ones. We will continue to provide support for our teammates and patients in the days to come."
cases.narrative: Police were called to Freedom Park in Rockingham County for a shooting and found her next to her car, suffering from multiple gunshot wounds.
